name: Catcher: Dragon Realm
summary:
Step into the boots of a legendary Dragon Warrior in Catcher: Dragon Realm, an intense magical action game built exclusively for VR.
Wield a powerful enchanted gauntlet that lets you catch, transform, and throw elemental attacks back at waves of ferocious dragons and mythical beasts. Defend the last watchtower of mankind in a kingdom engulfed by blazing volcanoes, ancient forests, and cursed caverns.
